{"schema":1,"channel":"stable","target":"windows-x86_64","repository":"faintestbreath/FileManager-Updates","version":"1.1.1","notes":"FileManager 1.1.1 - corrected Windows x64 installer and updater handoff

- Fix updates started from the Start Menu failing because Setup kept the installation folder locked.
- Start the verified installer from its temporary download folder, allowing safe installation and rollback after FileManager exits.
- Preserve Settings, Notes, Favorites, font preferences, shortcuts and personal files.
- Keep signed metadata, complete download integrity checks and explicit user consent.

Existing 1.1.0 installations: close FileManager using Exit, then download and run this installer manually once. The earlier client's handoff bug can prevent its automatic installation; the correction applies to future updates started by 1.1.1.

Setup runs for your Windows account and asks before installing. Relaunch FileManager from Start Menu after Setup finishes. Required third-party licenses, Microsoft runtime terms and 7-Zip corresponding source remain included.

This installer is not Windows Authenticode publisher-signed. Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen prompt.
